clarifications.rule: Diagnostic gate is Stage 6 of Build pipeline, always
clarifications.rationale: BUILD-3 confirmed gate operates as stage, not mainline

clarifications.rule: Gate output is ALWAYS a report, never a code change
WARNING items become active risks, not blockers
clarifications.rationale: BUILD-3's JWT warning became R1, mitigated in BUILD-4

clarifications.rule: CRITICAL items block DELIVER, require REPAIR stage
clarifications.rationale: BUILD-3 had no critical items; define escalation path

clarifications.rule: Diagnostic must not exceed 25% of total build effort
clarifications.rationale: Anti-drift rule: if diagnostic >25% of time, build is misusing it

clarifications.rule: Diagnostic result is NOT product quality proof
clarifications.rationale: Gate detects gaps, does not prove quality
